aellui.key.hint: Esc or Delete while capturing — unbind
aellui.status.no_schematic: No schematic loaded — settings will apply once you load one
aellui.tip.budgets_add_up: The neighbour mod has its own budget of the same size; they add up
easyplacefixplus.config.chatMessages.too: The mod reports Easy Place in chat: server refusals, skipped cells and hints. Off (default) — it stays silent
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceAutoToo: Before a block starts breaking, the fastest suitable tool from your inventory is taken in hand — the way Easy Place already takes the right block for placing. A tool that would not drop the block never beats a bare hand. Survival only, and only while Easy Place mode is on
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceAutomat: How long after Litematica's Easy Place a click still counts as automated. Only such clicks are corrected
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceBlocksP: Automated placement pace, counted in game ticks — the same clock a server's timer check uses. 20 is a click every tick, 10 every other tick, 5 every fourth; holding right-click in vanilla gives 5. Never more than one automated click per tick, whatever the value. Default 10 — twice as fast as a hand and invisible to most anticheats; if the server complains about speed, use 5. Clicks outside the schematic (chest, door, lever) are never throttled
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceConfirm: How long one click waits for the server to confirm the new count before another click is allowed. Raise it on a laggy server
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceDebug.t: Every Easy Place decision as a grey chat line: where the click went, what the schematic wants, why the click was cancelled or passed. Turn it on when something does not place — the lines show which check eats the click. Repeats are collapsed
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceDigGuar: Do not dig the wrong thing

While Litematica's Easy Place mode is on, a left click does not break blocks outside the schematic area or blocks already standing exactly as the schematic asks. Only leftover or wrong material inside the area can be dug. A short note above the hotbar says why a hit was refused. Off — digging works as usual
Do not break blocks outside the schematic area. Off — digging outside is allowed, only correctly placed blocks stay protected

Do not break blocks that already match the schematic. A block that differs only in what it adjusts to its neighbours by itself also counts as correct: stair corners, fence and pane connections, leaves
The guard works only while Litematica's Easy Place mode is on. Off — it always protects while a schematic is shown
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceFinishT: Vanilla pairs where a block turns into another one under a tool: copper scraped back with an axe or waxed with a honeycomb, dirt tilled into farmland with a hoe or flattened into a path with a shovel, a candle set on a cake, a pumpkin carved with shears (face where the schematic has it). The mod clicks the block already standing in the cell and never places a block into another cell. Where the block has no survival item at all (candle cake, farmland, path) the base block goes down first — but only when the finishing tool is in your inventory. With Material HUD it also works in «only blocks from inventory» mode: a standing block you can finish with a tool from your inventory is not hidden
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceFix.too: Master switch. Off — Litematica places exactly as it did before
easyplacefixplus.config.uiStyle.name: Look
easyplacefixplus.config.uiStyle.tooltip: Aell UI — the mod's own look. Vanilla — Minecraft's own buttons, toggles, fields and sliders; settings as tiles in two columns like Minecraft's Options (right-click a tile to reset it). Vanilla+ — the same, but settings as rows like Litematica: name on the left, value tile and Reset on the right. With Litematica Material HUD installed, Aell UI here means: use its look.
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceFixFill: Glowstone into respawn anchors, eyes of ender into end portal frames, water into cauldrons — bottle by bottle to the level (a full one may take a bucket), lava and powder snow by bucket. Easy Place places the cauldron empty and fills it next. Off by default because it uses up items
Flint and steel or a fire charge lights candles, candle cakes and campfires; a shovel puts a campfire out; a bare hand snuffs a candle
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceFixWate: A water bucket fills the block, an empty bucket drains it, so waterlogged matches the schematic
Adds a random extra tick to the pause between automated clicks, so the interval is not perfectly regular. A hand never clicks with metronome precision, and some timer anticheats flag exactly even timing. Costs a little speed; turn it on only if the server still complains at a lower blocks-per-second
The mod stops feeding a made-up view angle to get the right block side and clicks with the angle you already have. No snap turns in the packets — the thing anticheats look at most. The price: blocks whose facing comes from your look have to be placed by hand or skipped
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlacePoseAhe: The mod stops sending rotation packets of its own: the angle it needs rides the client’s own movement packet and the click goes out on the next tick. Exactly one movement packet per tick leaves the client, like vanilla, and that is what a server-side timer check counts. The price: a cell that needs turning is placed one tick later, and while the angle is held the server does not see where you really look, so a left-click in that window is resolved from the substituted angle
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceOnlySch: A guard against stray blocks: while Easy Place is working, nothing the cell does not ask for can be placed inside the schematic area — both Litematica's own misses (an extra fence next to the schematic one) and accidental clicks with the wrong block die quietly. May reduce accuracy: a disputed click is cancelled silently, and in rare cases a needed one gets caught — if something stops placing, turn this off
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceGiveUpR: Give up on cells the server refuses

If the server refuses a placement in the same cell six times in a row, Easy Place stops clicking it until the cell changes, and says so in chat. Turn this off if you place a block in the same spot over and over — say, rerolling villager trades with a lectern: the mod will always click and stay quiet
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceStrictS: An iron guard: no block goes into an empty schematic cell — neither from Easy Place nor placed by hand. Works only within the schematic (the boxes of enabled sub-regions of enabled placements): outside it everything places as usual. The click is dropped before it reaches the server and «off the schematic» shows above the hotbar. Right-clicking chests, doors, levers and the like without sneaking works as usual. Wrong blocks in schematic cells are stopped by the neighbouring «Block placing the wrong block»
easyplacefixplus.message.strict_empty: Off the schematic: %s does not go here — the schematic is empty here
easyplacefixplus.message.strict_other: Wrong block: the schematic wants %2$s here, not %1$s
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceStrictB: An iron guard: a cell where the schematic wants a block takes only that block — from Easy Place and by hand alike; any other block is dropped before it reaches the server and «wrong block» shows above the hotbar. Works only within the schematic; empty schematic cells and everything outside are left alone (empty cells are covered by «Block placing off the schematic»). Right-clicking chests, doors, levers without sneaking works as usual
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceOpenCon: Chests, barrels, shulkers, furnaces and hoppers open while Easy Place is on. Normally four separate guards eat that click: Schematic only, Litematica's own refusal on an occupied cell, its Placement Restriction, and the aim being moved to an unbuilt cell. The click is let through when you aim straight at the container, are not sneaking, the schematic asks for nothing against that face within the active layer — and the right button was just pressed rather than held from building: held RMB still places blocks and never pops a chest open. Placing a block against a container still works the vanilla way, by sneaking
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceReplace: Dirt, grass block, coarse dirt, dirt path, rooted dirt, podzol and mycelium: when the cell holds one of them and the schematic asks for another, the mod digs the wrong one out and the next Easy Place pass puts the right one down. Where a hoe or shovel can convert the block in place, that is done instead (see "Finish blocks with tools"). Off by default because it breaks blocks
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceSkipWro: Skip what would go in wrong

If no click can give the facing, axis, half or attachment the schematic asks for — usually because the block it must attach to is not built yet — the position is skipped instead of placed wrong. Come back to it once the support is there
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceDirtFor: When the schematic asks for a grass block and you have none, the mod places plain dirt and counts the cell as done: grass spreads back from the neighbours on its own if there is light above. A real grass block in the inventory always wins. While the toggle is off, a cell with dirt stays unfinished
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceEntitie: Easy Place places armor stands, cushions, item frames, paintings, end crystals and minecarts from the schematic: aim at the entity's ghost. The mod takes the item, clicks the supporting block and turns the head the way the ghost faces; it puts the item into a frame and rotates it. A painting is placed only if the game would pick a motive of the same size; boats are not placed
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceStripLo: When the schematic wants a stripped log or wood and you only have the plain one, the mod places the plain block and strips it with an axe from your inventory — the same way a candle is placed and then lit. A stripped block in the inventory wins; the axe takes durability
easyplacefixplus.config.easyPlaceVanilla: Litematica can encode the wanted state into the hit position (the Easy Place protocol), but only a server that supports it decodes that. If the server is plain and blocks come out facing wrong, turn this on: the mod sends honest geometric clicks and skips the positions it cannot get right
easyplacefixplus.config.openSettings.too: Opens this screen straight from the game
easyplacefixplus.config.toggleFix.name: Turn the fix on and off
easyplacefixplus.config.toggleFix.toolti: Switches the whole mod without opening any screen. Off — Litematica places exactly as it did before
easyplacefixplus.config.toggleStrictSche: Block placing off the schematic: on/off
Switches the option from the keyboard without opening the screen. No key by default
easyplacefixplus.config.toggleDigGuard.n: Do not dig the wrong thing: on/off
easyplacefixplus.config.toggleDigGuard.t: Switches the option from the keyboard without opening the screen. No key by default
easyplacefixplus.dig_guard.correct: Easy Place: this block already matches the schematic
easyplacefixplus.dig_guard.outside: Easy Place: this block is outside the schematic
easyplacefixplus.message.ep_foreign_rest: Easy Place module is off — EasyPlaceFix re-enabled
easyplacefixplus.message.ep_foreign_supp: EasyPlaceFix detected and disabled — Easy Place fixes are handled by EasyPlaceFixPlus (turn our Easy Place module off to hand control back)
easyplacefixplus.message.ep_refused: Easy Place: the server refused this cell too many times (%s %s %s) — skipping it. Usually the cell holds a block other than the one in the schematic: break it and the mod will come back. To keep the mod from giving up on cells, turn off "Give up on cells the server refuses" on the Easy Place tab
easyplacefixplus.message.ep_skipped_wron: Easy Place: skipping cell %s %s %s — no available click would place the block in the orientation the schematic asks for. This is the “Skip wrong state” setting at work: turn it off if you would rather have the block placed anyway
easyplacefixplus.message.ep_entity_missi: Easy Place: %1$s at %2$s %3$s %4$s needs %5$s, and there is none in your inventory
easyplacefixplus.message.ep_entity_reaso: Easy Place does not place boats: the game puts a boat where the player looks and turns it the way the player faces, so one click cannot match both the spot and the rotation
a bigger painting fits here and the game would pick it. Place it by hand or take a painting with this motive from creative mode
it would face the wrong way, and “Don't turn the player” forbids turning the head
the server rejected it three times, trying again in 10 seconds
the bottom is out of sight: the server puts a cushion into a cauldron, hopper or composter where your line of sight lands. Stand higher
easyplacefixplus.message.ep_missing_data: Easy Place: cell %2$s %3$s %4$s needs %1$s — an item with exactly those block data (a banner with that pattern, a pot with those sherds), and there is none in your inventory. The material list only asks for the plain item: Litematica caches the required item per block state, and the pattern is not part of the state. Until you craft it, the cell stays empty — placing the plain one would be wrong on purpose
easyplacefixplus.message.strict_schemati: Block placing off the schematic: on
Block placing off the schematic: off
easyplacefixplus.message.dig_guard_on: Do not dig the wrong thing: on
easyplacefixplus.message.dig_guard_off: Do not dig the wrong thing: off
easyplacefixplus.section.easy_place_digg: Easy Place is about placing; these two help with the left click next to it. Both are off by default and work only while Litematica's Easy Place mode is on (the dig guard can be allowed to work without it)
easyplacefixplus.section.easy_place_fixe: Every automated Easy Place click is checked against the schematic. Always on: the right state and facing by click selection, exact counts for candles and pickles, aim help for small ghosts, vines and hanging plants, potted plants, shelf protection

Every automated Easy Place click is checked against the schematic. Always on: the right state and facing by click selection, exact counts for candles and pickles, aim help for small ghosts, vines and hanging plants, potted plants, shelf protection. Litematica Material HUD is installed as well and carries the same module — the settings here and there are one and the same, and the engine is run by this mod.
easyplacefixplus.section.easy_place_serv: The anticheat does not know Easy Place is allowed on the server — it only sees packets. Placement pace, no view spoofing and honest click geometry keep the allowed Easy Place indistinguishable from hand building; which one to enable for which complaint — see the documentation
easyplacefixplus.section.easy_place_tool: When the state cannot be reached by placing, the mod uses the matching item from your inventory once per click, and only towards the schematic state
easyplacefixplus.section.keys.note: Unbound by default so nothing clashes with your other mods
easyplacefixplus.section.ui_style.note: Aell UI is the default look. Vanilla and Vanilla+ switch every window to Minecraft's own look and sounds; they differ only in how this settings screen is laid out.
easyplacefixplus.ui.gate.dig_guard_off: "Do not dig the wrong thing" is off
easyplacefixplus.ui.status.litematica_of: Easy Place is turned off in Litematica — this mod only corrects its clicks, so there is nothing to do yet
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.easyplace: Fixes wrong block placement in Litematica's Easy Place and extends it — no cheat options. Blocks land exactly as the schematic drew them: slabs, stairs, logs, rails, double chests, levers. What would land wrong is skipped; what placing can't finish is done with one click of a tool you carry.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.easyplacefixp: Fixes wrong block placement in Litematica's Easy Place — no cheat options.
easyplacefixplus.section.ghost_support.n: For blocks that hang on something: hanging signs, glow berries, pale hanging moss, vines. With Material HUD installed these options live on its Highlight tab.
easyplacefixplus.config.ghostHideUnsuppo: Do not draw holograms of blocks that cannot be placed yet because nothing holds them in the world: a hanging sign without a ceiling or a wall, glow berries and pale hanging moss with nothing above, a vine in the air, a torch without a floor. A chain of the same kind counts as held when its first link is. Easy Place aims through such cells. The hologram appears as soon as the support is built
easyplacefixplus.config.ghostSupportFrom: If a block of the visible layer cannot be placed because its support lies in the next layer (a hanging sign on layer N, the ceiling block on layer N+1), that support block is shown too and Easy Place can place it, although it is outside the layer. Only for layer modes; off by default
